sar_ais_distance_calibration.method: GeoTrackNet-style percentile of the CONFIRMED same-vessel (identity-matched) nearest-AIS distance distribution; the full SAR population is a true-match + dark-vessel mixture and is reported only for context

percentile_choice.matched_basis: median offset of a confirmed same-vessel pair
percentile_choice.likely_spoofed_basis: a-contrario: a confirmed pair exceeds this only FAR of the time

misattribution_screen.method: src.sar_ais_quality.screen_identity_pairs -- bracket check (own AIS brackets the SAR pass yet stays > 15 km away, or no own AIS within +/-2 h) + alternative-vessel check (a different vessel <= 5 km from the SAR point and <= half the attributed distance)
misattribution_screen.runs_on: every calibration (GFW SAR->MMSI mis-attribution is a general dense-traffic data-quality issue, not region-specific)

excluded_pairs.reason: bracket=unsupported (no own AIS bin within +/-2 h of the SAR pass); alternative vessel 2.22 km from SAR point (<= 5 km and <= 0.5x the attributed 12.4 km)
alternative vessel 2.33 km from SAR point (<= 5 km and <= 0.5x the attributed 10.1 km)
alternative vessel 1.51 km from SAR point (<= 5 km and <= 0.5x the attributed 14.4 km)

all_pairs_percentiles_km.note: MIXTURE (true matches + genuine dark vessels) -- not used for thresholds

likely_spoofed_tail_check.note: no gross outliers beyond the Tukey far-out fence; p99 is not tail-driven

sar_ais_distance_calibration.confidence_note: only 144 confirmed identity pairs (< 200); this is a single short control window, not a multi-week baseline. The 99th percentile is near the sample maximum -- treat likely_spoofed_min as indicative. Pull a longer baseline and drop the false-alarm rate to 0.001 for an operational value.

st_dbscan_calibration.method_spatial: Bai et al. adaptive DBSCAN: knee (Kneedle-lite) of the sorted 1-nearest contemporaneous inter-vessel distance curve, floored at 3.0 km
st_dbscan_calibration.method_temporal: ceil of the 90th percentile of the per-vessel successive-AIS-bin gap, floored at 2x temporal resolution

manual_comparison.status: PROVISIONAL -- tail-outlier concern RESOLVED (automated); eps/geometry spot-check still outstanding
manual_comparison.note: No hand-calibrated thresholds exist for this region, so manual_reference stays unset and these values are not yet cleared for operational classification. resolved: tail-outlier / GFW SAR->AIS mis-attribution: now screened automatically on every calibration run (bracket + alternative-vessel checks). Method validated 5/5 against the original India tail in src/inspect_india_tail_outliers.py.
remaining_checks_before_promotion: Sample ~8-10 KEPT confirmed pairs (144 available) across the tiers on a folium map (SAR point + own +/-2 h track), same visual sanity check used for qatar_gnss_spoofing_oct2025 / hormuz_control; confirm near-cutoff 'matched' pairs are visibly the same vessel.
Sanity-check eps_spatial against the region's lane / anchorage geometry -- it must not bridge the inbound vs outbound approach lanes.
Sanity-check eps_temporal: New Mangalore's is 6 h (vs the Gulf's 2 h) from sparser AIS coverage -- confirm that reflects real coverage and note the effect on ST-DBSCAN temporal permissiveness.
Only after those, fill in manual_reference and drop the PROVISIONAL status.
